name: 05_supplier_name_substring_collision
description: The current document's supplier ('PO Solutions Group Ltd') textually CONTAINS the name of a different, unrelated supplier ('Solutions Group') that has its own confidently-learned (usage_count=4) but WRONG po_number hint. A naive substring match ('a in b or b in a') would let that unrelated supplier's hint fire on this document. The correct behaviour is to use the document's own freshly-extracted po_number and ignore the unrelated hint entirely.
represents: The general collision-bug CLASS (not the one specific 'PO'/'Polychemtex' pair already fixed): any time one supplier's name is a substring of another's — which is common with holding-company/subsidiary/rebrand naming — naive substring matching cross-contaminates their learned data. This is the regression guard for the exact-match fix in engine.py::_apply_hints and anchor.py::_anchor_matches.
